holdout_policy: Do not execute until source and selected policy are committed. Run chosen policy plus same-seed controls, no parameter tuning after opening.
selection: Reject any hard invariant failure. Prefer more actual two-sided geometry-revision cases with valid native joints, then fewer still-required obligations, then lower work/round count. Report complete proposals and all failed cases separately. No per-case policy picking.
same_frame_controls: Initial FRAME proposal and identical eligible/shared masks with no peer offers; one-sided adaptation controls; changed frames are not attributed to solver improvements.
claim_rules: Local caps never satisfy foreign-required connectors. Coordinator creates zero architecture cells. No physics support certificate.
memory: Conservative preflight bound includes initial and four round snapshot pairs, native donor scratch, component claims and ledgers. Enforced before output allocations.
windows: Native Windows executable and source-matched Godot bridge; actual input Apply Undo Save exit/reopen required; Linux tests do not substitute Windows acceptance.
